title: Edmund and the Will
author: Kestrel Nystrom
blurb: Tamsin Marchetti, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
